mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%, or remain negative for less than 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust demand and labor market strength, amplifying equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-positive despite both proxies moving in expected directions, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly job openings (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not turn positive when PAYEMS continues to rise, or remain negative despite sustained job growth.

mechanism_narrative: An index of industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 100 signals robust supply-side activity, reducing production costs and stimulating investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to turn positive when INDPRO crosses above 100, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Both quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (RSAFS) rising simultaneously indicate robust demand across sectors, driving equity valuations higher and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain non-positive despite both proxies rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a combination of falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) and near-zero federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals maximum accommodative policy, fostering sustained economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to turn positive when both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A post-recession recovery is indicated by industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105 and unemployment (UNRATE) below 5%, creating a favorable macro environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain non-positive despite both proxies meeting their thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
